extracted.intended_audience: general readers; students of classic literature; readers of Cervantes/Don Quixote
extracted.subtask_description: An excerpt from Miguel de Cervantes' Don Quixote containing comic episodes (the enchanted bark, the windmills/mills, and the duke and duchess entertaining Don Quixote and Sancho). Intended as narrative fiction illustrating satire, chivalric parody, and character humor.
